sigma_y_residual_prediction.note: Analytical derivation of the SU(2) sigma_y fit angle from the Bazavan Eq. 1 carrier term H_A(t) = -Omega_c*sigma_y*cos(delta*t). Since sigma_y commutes with itself in time, the accumulated propagator is U_A(T) = exp(-i * scalar * sigma_y) with scalar = -(Omega_c/delta) * sin(delta*T).
sigma_y_residual_prediction.correction_cost_note: sigma_y residual is a single unconditional carrier rotation on the qubit. Absorbed into any adjacent QT step (QT is a resonant carrier drive that trivially includes arbitrary spin rotations); circuit cost = 0. Standalone cost (single carrier pulse at Meth Omega_c=97.56 kHz): 0.827 us.
